order_returns_pre_cutover_alone.name: order_returns_pre_cutover_alone
order_returns_pre_cutover_alone.value: not ("order_returns"."pre_cutover" and ("order_returns"."restocked" or "order_returns"."refurb_product_id" is not null))

order_returns_restocked_has_batch.name: order_returns_restocked_has_batch
order_returns_restocked_has_batch.value: ("order_returns"."restocked" or "order_returns"."refurb_product_id" is not null) = ("order_returns"."batch_id" is not null)

products_variant_needs_group.name: products_variant_needs_group
products_variant_needs_group.value: "products"."variant_name" is null or "products"."group_id" is not null

products_cost_date_needs_cost.name: products_cost_date_needs_cost
products_cost_date_needs_cost.value: "products"."unit_cost_updated_at" is null or "products"."unit_cost" is not null

products_stock_range.name: products_stock_range
products_stock_range.value: ("products"."min_stock" is null and "products"."max_stock" is null) or ("products"."min_stock" is not null and "products"."max_stock" is not null and "products"."min_stock" >= 0 and "products"."max_stock" > "products"."min_stock")

purchase_order_amendments_shape.name: purchase_order_amendments_shape
purchase_order_amendments_shape.value:
case "purchase_order_amendments"."kind"
				when 'added' then "purchase_order_amendments"."quantity_after" is not null and "purchase_order_amendments"."quantity_before" is null
				when 'removed' then "purchase_order_amendments"."quantity_before" is not null and "purchase_order_amendments"."quantity_after" is null
				when 'quantity' then "purchase_order_amendments"."quantity_before" is not null and "purchase_order_amendments"."quantity_after" is not null
				else "purchase_order_amendments"."quantity_before" is null and "purchase_order_amendments"."quantity_after" is null
			end

purchase_order_discounts_receipt_units.name: purchase_order_discounts_receipt_units
purchase_order_discounts_receipt_units.value: "purchase_order_discounts"."receipt_id" is null or "purchase_order_discounts"."units" is not null

purchase_order_lines_sent_cost_needs_sen.name: purchase_order_lines_sent_cost_needs_sent
purchase_order_lines_sent_cost_needs_sen.value: "purchase_order_lines"."sent_unit_cost" is null or "purchase_order_lines"."sent_quantity" is not null

transfers_sent_moved.name: transfers_sent_moved
transfers_sent_moved.value: ("transfers"."status" = 'sent') = ("transfers"."batch_id" is not null and "transfers"."sent_at" is not null)
